envelope.description: Create the per-repository registry and wire the approval and daemon review paths

body.title: Create the per-repository registry and wire the approval and daemon review paths
body.summary: Add the daemon's per-repository registry (file sidecar store, file journal, History, ArtifactStore, LifecycleService with createCompletionEvidence as its per-call factory) and pass its service and the request's person actor, falling back to insrc:approval, to the workflow.approve handler in src/daemon/index.ts, the review-decision step and workflowReviewStart; a registry entry that cannot be created refuses the request with that error.
acceptanceChecks: workflow.approve, the review-decision step and workflow.review each use the repository's durable service and refuse a head that is ahead of its log
the actor is the request's person actor when supplied and insrc:approval otherwise
a repository whose registry entry cannot be created is refused and the head-only path is not used inside the daemon
the existing gates, review-decision and daemon workflow tests pass unchanged

tests.name: lifecycle-wiring.test.ts: the daemon approve handler, the review-decision step and workflowReviewStart use the repository's durable LifecycleService, refuse a head ahead of its log, use the request's person actor or insrc:approval, and a repository whose registry entry cannot be created is refused
